notes: The release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml, "Build and Test") runs `make prepublish`, which is Makefile.source.mjs's prepublish target: set-module-type commonjs, the build of all packages with IS_PUBLISH, the tests, set-module-type clean. These are its commands without the tests. It publishes with Yarn (release-tool), so Yarn packs here too; Yarn is the release the repository commits (.yarn/releases, named by yarnPath). Node: from 7.28.5 the workflow's npm-release job sets `node-version: latest`, and the build needs it (Node 20 stops with a SyntaxError). Node 25 gives the published files of 7.28.5, 7.28.6 and 7.29.7: every package identical. A later release made when "latest" was a newer Node may need its own recipe. Up to 7.28.4 see babel.
